notes: Capability-focused Seed1.5-Thinking RL technical report (arXiv:2504.13914). No safety/alignment/jailbreak/toxicity/honesty/dangerous-capability benchmark numbers. Qualitative claims only: SFT reduces hallucination and harmfulness vs base-model RL start (topics harmful_requests and hallucination). SFT mix listing “safety” is training data only—does not cover topics. Reward-hacking text is about Seed-Verifier / training interference, not a Seed1.5-Thinking behavior result—left reward_hacking uncovered. Paper Date April 10, 2025 is not a model release date. 32k token truncate is SFT training length, not stated inference context. Table 1 verifier accuracy is incomplete in the text layer (likely figure) and is not a safety eval. Skipped all capability benches in Table 2/3/4 and human preference win-rate: AIME 2024/2025, BeyondAIME, GPQA diamond, SuperGPQA, MMLU-PRO, Codeforces, LiveCodeBench v5, Aider Polyglot, SWE-bench verified, ARC-AGI, SimpleQA (factuality QA—capability), Collie, IFEval, RFT ablation, DAPO/VAPO rankings. Appendix creative-writing cases mention “safety” only as roleplay dialogue about Claude/GPT, not model evals. Covers bytedance/doubao-1.5-thinking-pro (Seed1.5-Thinking); Doubao-Pro 1.5 is only a data/preference source, not this report’s subject.
